0022600190.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-6, 5th in the Atlantic and 13th in the East, 5.5 games back) visit the Atlanta Hawks (5-4, 1st in the Southeast and 4th in the East) for the Nets' ninth game of the season. Brooklyn is 1-3 on the road and has won its last game, while Atlanta is 4-2 on the road and has won its last two. Demin is out for Brooklyn with a leg bruise, and Clowney is day-to-day with knee soreness and is a game-time decision. Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but in 2025-26 the Nets lost all four meetings, most recently 141-107 in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
